import pytest
from calendar_core.slots import Event, overlaps, free_slots, parse_time, fmt_duration


def test_issue_back_to_back_no_overlap():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    # 9*60=540, 10*60=600, 11*60=660
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)) is False


def test_issue_back_to_back_reversed_no_overlap():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    # 10*60=600, 11*60=660, 9*60=540, 10*60=600
    assert overlaps(Event(600, 660), Event(540, 600)) is False


def test_issue_one_minute_overlap():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    # 9*60=540, 10*60+1=601, 10*60=600, 11*60=660; shared minute is 600
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 601), Event(600, 660)) is True


def test_issue_identical_events_overlap():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    # 9*60=540, 10*60=600; identical intervals share minutes 540-599
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(540, 600)) is True


def test_issue_contained_event_overlaps():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    # outer 9*60=540 to 11*60=660, inner 9*60+20=560 to 9*60+40=580
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 660), Event(560, 580)) is True


def test_issue_back_to_back_leaves_no_free_slot():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    # day 9*60=540 to 11*60=660 fully covered by [540,600)+[600,660)
    assert free_slots([Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)], 540, 660) == []


def test_contract_unsorted_events_sorted_gaps():
    """free_slots returns the gaps as (start, end) tuples sorted by start."""
    # day 9*60=540 to 12*60=720; covers [540,560) and [660,700); gaps 560-660 and 700-720
    assert free_slots([Event(660, 700), Event(540, 560)], 540, 720) == [(560, 660), (700, 720)]


def test_contract_events_clipped_to_day():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    # event 8*60+20=500 to 9*60+20=560 clipped to [540,560); day 9*60=540 to 11*60=660
    assert free_slots([Event(500, 560)], 540, 660) == [(560, 660)]


def test_contract_short_gaps_filtered():
    """Only gaps of at least min_minutes are returned."""
    # gap 11*60-10*60=660-600=60 < 61 so filtered out
    assert free_slots([Event(540, 600)], 540, 660, min_minutes=61) == []


def test_contract_free_slots_empty_returns_whole_day():
    """free_slots returns the gaps inside [day_start, day_end) not covered by any event."""
    # day 9*60=540 to 11*60=660 with no events leaves whole day free
    assert free_slots([], 540, 660) == [(540, 660)]


def test_contract_parse_time_valid():
    """parse_time turns "HH:MM" (24-hour) into minutes."""
    # 9*60+0=540
    assert parse_time("09:00") == 540


def test_contract_parse_time_invalid():
    """Anything it cannot parse raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_time("not-a-time")


def test_contract_fmt_duration():
    """fmt_duration renders "Xh YYm" (e.g. 65 -> "1h 05m")."""
    # 65=1*60+5 -> "1h 05m"
    assert fmt_duration(65) == "1h 05m"
